problem: The helix-cli currently has no ns-gm or NetSuite-related commands in its inspect module. After ns-gm moves server-side, sandbox agents will need to access NetSuite data through `hlx inspect netsuite` (or similar) subcommand that routes queries through the server-side inspection proxy.

files.why: Inspect subcommand router. Currently dispatches to repos, db, logs, api. Must be extended with a netsuite subcommand.
Database inspection implementation. Serves as a template for the netsuite implementation — same pattern: parse args, call hxFetch, display results.
Logs inspection implementation. Another template showing the subcommand pattern.
API inspection implementation. Template for new subcommand.
Lists available repositories and their inspection types. Must display new NETSUITE type when available.
HTTP transport layer with retry logic. Calls /api/inspect/* endpoints. Will be used by new netsuite subcommand to POST queries to the server.
Repository name/ID resolution used by all inspect commands.
Main CLI entry point. Routes 'inspect' to runInspect().
User-facing command documentation. Must be updated with new netsuite subcommand.
Build scripts: build=tsc, typecheck=tsc --noEmit, test=tsc && node --test.

facts: No ns-gm, nsgm, or NetSuite references exist in helix-cli src/ (confirmed by grep)
hlx inspect currently has 4 subcommands: repos, db, logs, api (src/inspect/index.ts)
The CLI communicates with the server at /api/inspect/* endpoints via hxFetch() in src/lib/http.ts
Authentication uses either hxi_ API keys (X-API-Key header) or Bearer tokens (Authorization header)
HTTP client has retry logic: 3 attempts, exponential backoff, retryable on 429/5xx
Each inspect subcommand follows the same pattern: parse flags, resolve repo, call hxFetch, display results
The skill-content directory has no ns-gm documentation
unknowns: What the netsuite subcommand's interface should look like — whether it mirrors ns-gm CLI syntax or uses a new syntax (e.g., `hlx inspect netsuite --repo X --query 'SuiteQL'`)
Whether multiple netsuite subcommands are needed (suiteql, saved-search, script-logs, record) or a single generic one
Whether the repos subcommand already handles NETSUITE type display or needs changes
